messages.text:
Start server functions need the Start runtime context, so direct-calling them in Vitest is the wrong shape.

I’m splitting the backend handlers into a plain server API module and keeping the Start server functions as wrappers; tests can verify the backend behavior directly, while routes still cross the real Start boundary.
